verdict.rationale: Notion's webhooks send HTTP POSTs when pages, properties, or comments change, so engineers can build event-triggered automations on internal connections (which are pitched as "ideal for custom automations and workflows"). Custom Agents are marketed as keeping work moving 24/7. However, the event handling and any scheduling must run in the engineer's own external infrastructure, and nothing documents native schedule or recurring triggers. Missing for 10: a native scheduled/cron-style workflow trigger, first-party automation builder documentation, evidence that Custom Agents can run on a schedule, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
